sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests the scope of the Antiterrorism and Effective Death Penalty Act. The statute imposes a one-year limit on federal habeas petitions. The limit follows the finality of a state criminal conviction. The parties dispute whether this limit applies to the current petition.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The outcome defines the deadline for federal habeas petitions. It determines when prisoners must file these claims. It shapes the scope of federal review of state convictions. It affects the balance between finality and individual rights.
